entries.title: John 20:1
segments: Now on the first [day] of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, while it was yet dark, unto the tomb, and seeth the stone taken away from the tomb.

entries.title: John 20:2
segments: She runneth therefore, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we know not where they have laid him.

entries.title: John 20:3
segments: Peter therefore went forth, and the other disciple, and they went toward the tomb.

entries.title: John 20:4
segments: And they ran both together: and the other disciple outran Peter, and came first to the tomb;

entries.title: John 20:5
segments: and stooping and looking in, he seeth the linen cloths lying; yet entered he not in.

entries.title: John 20:6
segments: Simon Peter therefore also cometh, following him, and entered into the tomb; and he beholdeth the linen cloths lying,

entries.title: John 20:7
segments: and the napkin, that was upon his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

entries.title: John 20:8
segments: Then entered in therefore the other disciple also, who came first to the tomb, and he saw, and believed.

entries.title: John 20:9
segments: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

entries.title: John 20:10
segments: So the disciples went away again unto their own home.

entries.title: John 20:11
segments: But Mary was standing without at the tomb weeping: so, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb;

entries.title: John 20:12
segments: and she beholdeth two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

entries.title: John 20:13
segments: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

entries.title: John 20:14
segments: When she had thus said, she turned herself back, and beholdeth Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

entries.title: John 20:15
segments: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou hast borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

entries.title: John 20:16
segments: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turneth herself, and saith unto him in Hebrew, Rabboni; which is to say, Teacher.

entries.title: John 20:17
segments: Jesus saith to her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended unto the Father: but go unto my brethren, and say to them, I ascend unto my Father and your Father, and my God and your God.

entries.title: John 20:18
segments: Mary Magdalene cometh and telleth the disciples, I have seen the Lord; and [that] he had said these things unto her.

entries.title: John 20:19
segments: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first [day] of the week, and when the doors were shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you.

entries.title: John 20:20
segments: And when he had said this, he showed unto them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad, when they saw the Lord.

entries.title: John 20:21
segments: Jesus therefore said to them again, Peace [be] unto you: as the Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

entries.title: John 20:22
segments: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Spirit:

entries.title: John 20:23
segments: whose soever sins ye forgive, they are forgiven unto them; whose soever [sins] ye retain, they are retained.

entries.title: John 20:24
segments: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

entries.title: John 20:25
segments: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.

entries.title: John 20:26
segments: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them. Jesus cometh, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace [be] unto you.

entries.title: John 20:27
segments: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and see my hands; and reach [hither] thy hand, and put it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

entries.title: John 20:28
segments: Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

entries.title: John 20:29
segments: Jesus saith unto him, Because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed [are] they that have not seen, and [yet] have believed.

entries.title: John 20:30
segments: Many other signs therefore did Jesus in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book:

entries.title: John 20:31
segments: but these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye may have life in his name.
